name: read-rows
description: Reads rows from a Google Sheets tab or range as objects keyed by row 1. Spreadsheet can be a browser URL or an id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets; tab names come from google-sheets__list-tabs. A range must omit the tab name and include row 1 for correct headers.

spreadsheet.description: Spreadsheet URL copied from the browser, or spreadsheet id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets.

tab.description: Tab name from google-sheets__list-tabs. When omitted, the first tab is used.

range.description: Optional A1 range without a tab name, such as A1:F50. It must include row 1 for row 1 to be used as the header.

limit.description: Maximum number of data rows to return. Defaults to 100.
